_README: The Phase 2 golden set — the ruler every later number is measured with.
D06: hand-verified, NEVER auto-generated. AI may draft a question and propose
candidate answer chunks; only a human sets verified_by to 'human'. rag/score.py
refuses to score any item that is not human-verified, and says so loudly.
To verify one item: read the question, open the chunk it names (rag/chunk.py
carries source_path + char_start/char_end so the .rst opens at the exact spot),
confirm the answer is genuinely there, write one sentence in answer_note saying
what convinced you, then set verified_by to 'human' and verified_on to the date.
answerable, answer_chunks (list, omit when unanswerable), answer_note,
version_sensitive (optional, true when the VERSION is part of the right answer —
those items are scored version-strict, D58), verified_by, verified_on.
Target is 50 items (D61). Verified items have verified_by=human; everything else is a DRAFT for review.

items.question: engine.has_table() no longer exists, what is the replacement?
items.answer_note: Verified unanswerable from this corpus. `grep -c has_table corpus/chunks.jsonl` returns 0 — the string is in none of the 3284 chunks. Real 2.0 fix is inspect(engine).has_table(...), but that lives in the API reference (Sphinx from docstrings), which was never in the .rst tree we fetched (D07, D50, D45 ceiling).
